messages.subject: JavaGD and paths
messages.body_plain:
I ran into an error that I had not encountered before plotting some spatial polygon data with JavaGD.

> library(OpenStreetMap)
> data(states)
> plot(states)

Warning messages:
1: In polypath(x = mcrds[, 1], y = mcrds[, 2], border = border,  ... :
  Path rendering is not implemented for this device 
0
...

Can JavaGD be updated to handle paths, or am I missing something on my end?


best,
Ian
